reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Radix Primitives (https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives).
Technology stack: react, typescript, radix-ui.
Component specification: 最后开 Dialog。紫底按钮在演示，下面是源码和焦点陷阱。
Key visual & interaction patterns: Dialog、Tooltip、Accordion.
Visual details from source observation: 我们进 Primitives 首页，大标题说设计系统的核心积木，下面 Dialog、下拉、气泡三张卡在演示。体量在 Introduction：侧栏 Accordion 排到 Tooltip，正文写低层库、可渐进接入。点开 Dialog，紫底按钮下面是 radix-ui 的导入和焦点陷阱。适合要自绘皮的人；想开箱外观去 Themes。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
